about: NL-1: UCT's own meanings for words members use, as DATA the interpreter reads (not code, not regex). General trading slang is NOT listed: the model knows it and the eval measures it. Add a line here only for a meaning that is specific to UCT. Each entry needs an owner decision or an existing product rule as its source.

terms.means: highest / lowest RS Rank across UCT's whole Screener universe (say so); within a watchlist only when one is named

terms.words: best / top stocks, no measure named
terms.means: UCT Composite, the Screener's own default ranking (say so)

terms.words: a moving average given only by its length ("the 20", "a 50", "add the 9 and 21")
terms.means: EMA for 8, 9, 10, 20 and 21; SMA for 50 and longer; for any other length ask EMA or SMA. Words the member says ("20 sma") always win
the watchlist shown on the member's board

terms.words: this chart / it / here, for a chart
terms.means: the chart marked selected; with none selected, conversation_memory.subject_chart; otherwise ask which

terms.words: a trading concept a starter or saved screen already defines (breakouts, leaders, pullbacks, tight bases, gap movers)
terms.means: run that screen and name it; never invent criteria for it
